title: NOPE! Clothes Moth Traps | Odourless Non-Toxic Pheromone Sticky Trap | For Cupboards, Drawers & Clothes Storage Areas | Child & Pet Safe (6-pack)
bullet_points: PHEROMONE-POWERED MONITORING: Odourless moth catcher trap attracts male clothes moths (Tineola bisselliella) for up to 3 months, allowing you to get the full picture of a moth infestation’s scale.
OPTIMISED FOR CLOTHES MOTHS: Targets golden-bodied clothes moths with orange head hairs (Tineola bisselliella only). Not suitable for Indian meal moths, brown house moths or carpet beetles.
SIMPLE SET-UP: Peel, fold and place at 4–6 ft height in dark, quiet areas such as wardrobes, drawers or lofts to protect wool, silk, fur, leather, soft furnishings, plush toys and craft materials.

ESSENTIAL PEST CONTROL MEASURE: Reveals clothes moth activity so you can vacuum thoroughly, hot-wash fabrics and deploy NOPE! smoke bombs/sprays to eliminate larvae/adult moths as part of a targeted pest control strategy.

FOIL-FRESH & FAMILY-SAFE: Each moth sticky trap is foil-sealed for freshness. Once full, dispose in household waste. For moth prevention: maintain 40–50% humidity, vacuum clean regularly and keep clothes in sealed storage.
description: Pheromone-powered moth trap designed specifically for golden-bodied clothes moths (Tineola bisselliella), this odourless and foil-sealed sticky trap attracts males for up to 3 months to help assess the extent of an infestation. It’s not suitable for other pests like Indian meal moths, brown house moths or carpet beetles. Easy to use—just peel, fold and place the trap 4–6 ft high in dark, quiet areas such as wardrobes, drawers or lofts to protect fabrics like wool, silk, fur, leather, soft furnishings, plush toys and craft supplies. Acts as a key step in your pest control strategy by revealing moth presence so you can vacuum, wash affected items, and treat with NOPE! sprays or smoke bombs. For ongoing prevention, keep humidity between 40–50%, vacuum regularly and store garments in sealed containers. Once full, traps can be safely discarded in household waste.
